description: Borders around the changed characters in the diff view, with a live settings panel for backgrounds, borders, comment color and line number colors; keep several presets and switch in one click
command.openPanel.title: Open Settings Panel
command.switchPreset.title: Switch Preset
command.openSample.title: Open Sample Diff
command.clearColors.title: Remove Colors Written to Settings
command.showLog.title: Open Log
configuration.presets.description: Presets, maintained by the settings panel. Written to workspace settings (.vscode/settings.json), they follow version control and apply to that project only. Built-in presets are used when none are set.
configuration.activePreset.description: Name of the preset in use; the first preset is used when the name is not found
configuration.language.description: Language of this extension's notifications, status bar, settings panel and sample diff. Command names in the Command Palette always follow VS Code's display language.
